findings.title: Two current-board statements still name the superseded board 1407e850 as the current / this board
findings.contradicts: AGENTS.md section 1 R10 status paragraph and docs/M3_R10.md 'The board': the current R10 PCB is 92c3ad59174afe1ffe206f6384c8cd9a8962e09647ccd6a8c418b95b5312056f; docs/R10_VALIDATION.md 'Inventory basis' (line 2278): the section 1 inventory is for PCB 92c3ad59...; round24_fix_docs.md claims FMEA and the R10_VALIDATION section 1 inventory were bound to 92c3ad59.
findings.evidence: (a) docs/FMEA_REDUNDANCY.md line 86, row 'I-11, V-19, H-6 (R10)': '**Current R10 (`1407e850…`; the ports since the round 19 fix pass):**'. The committed board m3_design/assembly_review/m3.kicad_pcb has SHA-256 92c3ad59..., not 1407e850... (git show f2b8251:m3_design/assembly_review/m3.kicad_pcb | shasum -a 256 = 1407e8506efb..., the superseded round 24 board). The label was carried from '5516eeec…' (9b27268) to '1407e850…' (f2b8251) and not advanced in the round 24 fix pass. (b) docs/R10_VALIDATION.md line 2329, 'S-8 barrels' paragraph inside section 1 of 'R10 deviations for owner acceptance', whose stated basis is 92c3ad59: '6 of them carry plated barrels on this board (`1407e850…`), 12 barrels in all'. The barrel count itself is correct on 92c3ad59 (check_r10 run into the probe dir: S-8 evidence barrels 12, inner_rings 2), but the board it names as 'this board' / 'current' is wrong.
findings.impact: A reader of the FMEA (or of the owner-deviation detail) is told the current R10 design is a board that is no longer the committed one; the binding of those rows to the board under review is false as written.
findings.concrete_fix: FMEA_REDUNDANCY.md line 86: 'Current R10 (`92c3ad59…`; the ports since the round 19 fix pass)'. R10_VALIDATION.md line 2329: 'on this board (`92c3ad59…`, unchanged from `1407e850…`), 12 barrels in all'.

Board silk prints '1:E1-' with an ASCII hyphen; docs write `1:E1−` (Unicode minus); same legend.

coverage_limits: Docs are about 9,600 lines; current-state sections, coordinates, hashes, counts, cost/stock, pinouts, legends and links were checked mechanically or by reading; long narrative sections (M3_R10 Firmware, R10_VALIDATION round histories, ORDERING 8.3 checklist prose) were sampled, not read line by line.
